title: Text: DET Al Avila ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: Are you going to make any news in the next two hours? Heading into a meeting with my bosses, don’t want to be caught off guard

From Pirates

No quotes

Sinker 91, FB 93, slider, Change up are avg. plus control
